name: H_INERT
bar: >= 0.90 of all books hold L4_DD at EVERY E in END_Q (REC_FULL)

name: H_INERT_W
bar: >= 0.90 of all books hold L4_DD at EVERY E in END_Q (WIN)

name: H_BAR
bar: range(SPY |OOS MaxDD|) over END_Q >= 0.05 on at least one panel

name: H_STEP
bar: the largest single step in SPY |OOS MaxDD| is the one that first puts the 2020 trough IS, on both panels

name: H_CAPCUT
bar: the WIN cap at the LAST end <= 0.80 x the WIN cap at the FIRST end

name: H_BIND
bar: L4_DD's share of binding-leg sets (WIN) is >= 0.10 higher once the crash leaves the OOS window

name: H_VERDICT
bar: >= 0.90 of all books hold their 4b verdict at every E in END_Q (REC_FULL)

name: H_PANEL
bar: the two panels agree on the PASS/FAIL sign of H_INERT and H_VERDICT
